notes_for_editor: Moderate evidence: NRHP nomination, Light-House Board reports FY1893-1900, two Bulletin items, USLHS roster; Lighthouse Friends used for facts and the log quotes (second-hand). Not found: newspaper coverage (loc.gov search timed out), 1901-1950 annual-report detail. Tower height differs (NRHP 100 ft, station 103 ft, USLHS 96.5 ft to lantern). Characteristic given as Fl(2) 10s in 1895 sources vs Fl(2) W 15s in the record; modern range/status not verified. LHB page numbers given only where printed page is visible (FY1899 p.127, FY1900 p.120); other citations are by entry or scan page. Roster discrepancies: Trammell (archive 1962, LHF 1956); Roberts (Jr. vs III) listing. Dates of the 1900 storm not given in the report. Checker: opening sentence rewritten (Dog Island/rivers-behind claim was unsupported); location and city ownership now cited to Lighthouse Friends; FY1899 wharf work now labelled as fiscal year.
